caption:
After work, Lulu helps Mum in and out of bed, the car and the shower. Lower back, shoulders and forearms quietly take the load.

Remedial massage can ease muscle tightness and help you feel less wound up, and many carers find regular sessions easier to keep than a one-off. It complements, rather than replaces, staying active, strength work and good lifting habits.

Get close, bend your knees and turn with your feet. Back pain spreading into the leg or pain after an awkward lift is worth a physio assessment. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio are here for carers too. Book online via the link in bio
